name: CarbonFarmingPracticeLedger
tagline: Every regenerative practice, hectare, evidence item and tonne of CO2e – from field to issued credit.
description: Full Power Platform app for carbon programme aggregators, insetting schemes, agronomists and growers: record cover crops, reduced and no-till, nutrient, grazing, compost and agroforestry practices per field, estimate gross and net tCO2e with uncertainty and buffer deductions, catch over-enrolment and double counting, collect evidence, group entries into verification batches, record verifier findings and corrective actions and track credits issued.
features: Gross → net tCO2e calculation (factor, verifier adjustment, uncertainty, buffer)
Over-enrolment and stacking / double-counting checks per field and year
Practice, evidence and verification deadline calendar
Verifier findings, corrective actions and credit issuance
